jobs.job_title: AI Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic Systems
jobs.job_description:
AI Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic Systems

Location: Jakarta / Tangerang

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Technology / AI & Data

Reports to: Engineering Lead

Company Description

Kalyana Solutions (PT Kalyana Adikarya Abadi) is an Indonesian enterprise technology solutions and services provider that helps organizations modernize operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation.

Kalyana provides services across intelligent automation, enterprise AI, custom software development, data engineering and business intelligence, cybersecurity, and enterprise business applications. The company supports clients throughout the technology lifecycle, from assessment and solution design to development, integration, implementation, and ongoing support.

By combining technical expertise with a practical, business-focused approach, Kalyana delivers secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready solutions that address operational needs and create measurable business value.

About the Role

We are looking for a mid-level AI Engineer to build and deploy practical AI solutions for business use cases.

You will work on generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, document processing, machine learning, and system integration. This is a hands-on role covering solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and deploy production-ready AI applications.

• Develop generative AI and RAG solutions.

• Build AI agents with tool-calling capabilities.

• Integrate AI services with applications and APIs.

• Prepare structured and unstructured data for AI use cases.

• Build automated model evaluation and testing workflows.

• Monitor model quality, performance, usage, and cost.

• Deploy and support AI workloads in cloud environments.

• Apply security and responsible-AI practices.

• Document solutions and participate in code reviews.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Around 3–6 years of relevant engineering experience.

• Strong Python programming skills.

• Experience building production software, data, or AI applications.

• Experience using generative AI models or APIs.

• Understanding of prompts, structured outputs, RAG, and embeddings.

• Familiarity with AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows.

• Experience developing APIs and backend services.

• Experience with Git, testing, and CI/CD.

• Experience with at least one cloud platform.

• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.

• Experience with commercial or open-source language models.

• Experience with pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or OpenSearch.

• Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, or scikit-learn.

• Experience with document intelligence or multimodal AI.

• Familiarity with AI evaluation or observability tools.

• Docker experience is a strong plus.

• Kubernetes or MLOps experience is a plus.

• Experience in enterprise environments is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

• AI solutions progress successfully from prototype to production.

• Applications are reliable, secure, and maintainable.

• Model quality is measured and improved systematically.

• Solutions address clear business needs.

• Production issues are resolved effectively.

jobs.job_title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer – RAG & Intelligent Document Processing
jobs.job_description:
Trigyn is seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer with deep expertise in cloud-native architecture, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) to support the development and implementation of the OSFG AI-Enabled Document Review Agent. This role is critical in designing, building, and deploying the core technical infrastructure, retrieval pipelines, and AI orchestration engines, ensuring that the solutions are scalable, evidence-grounded, resilient, and aligned with modern cloud and standards. The Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer will play a pivotal role in engineering the asynchronous review runtime, integrating Azure AI Search and Microsoft Foundry LLM services, building structure-aware document extraction pipelines, and enforcing strict citation validation to eliminate AI hallucinations.

Key responsibilities

Develop page-aware, structure-preserving extraction pipelines using Azure AI Document Intelligence for complex safeguard documents (PDF/DOCX) to enable precise page-level citations.

Architect and deploy the Review Orchestration Runtime using Azure Container Apps and Azure Service Bus to handle asynchronous review processing, rule selection snapshots, and status polling endpoints.

Design and configure dual search indexes in Azure AI Search (separating submitted document evidence from authoritative framework references) implementing hybrid keyword/vector retrieval and rule-scoped queries.

Build and fine-tune Microsoft Foundry prompt templates and structured JSON output schemas, ensuring evidence-grounded finding generation, missing-evidence fallbacks, and model/prompt version stamping.

Implement citation and schema validation mechanics to verify that every AI finding is validated against retrieved source text and framework clauses prior to persistence.

Design and maintain the Dataverse review data model (covering Review Runs, Rule Versions, AI Findings, Evidence, and Specialist Decisions) while enabling seamless integration with ISMS and Power Apps workflows.

Configure security, identity, and observability controls utilizing Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product owners and safeguard specialists, to architect, build, and test full-stack AI components and backend services.

About you

Bachelor's degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.

Minimum 6 years of professional experience in full-stack AI and software engineering, with a strong track record of leading AI technical teams and engineering generative AI, NLP, computer vision, and large-scale data systems.

Deep expertise in RAG architecture design, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and enterprise search platforms utilizing Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, and custom embedding models.

Proven experience with cloud-native application development on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Microsoft Foundry endpoints.

Extensive experience in Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), document layout parsing, structure-aware chunking, and text extraction.

Hands-on experience designing relational data models in Dataverse and integrating AI calls within Microsoft Power Platform environments (Power Apps, Power Automate).

Practical experience building automated evaluation harnesses, citation validators, structured output schema enforcement, and telemetry monitoring using Application Insights and Log Analytics.

Proven track record of delivering high-quality, scalable, and secure AI software solutions, including production platforms serving enterprise user bases.

jobs.job_title: Applied AI / Full-Stack AI Engineer (Mandarin / English Speaker)
jobs.job_description:
About the role

Join our team at HITHINK TECHNOLOGY INDONESIA as Middle Applied AI / Fullstack AI Engineer (English/Chinese Speaker). This is a full-time position based in South Jakarta, Jakarta, offering you the opportunity to develop your skills and gain valuable experience in a dynamic, fast-paced technology environment.
We are looking for a Middle Applied AI / Full-Stack AI Engineer to build and deploy AI-powered applications, LLM features, and intelligent agent workflows.

You will combine AI/LLM engineering with full-stack development, taking AI features from concept to production while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency. You will work closely with Product, Design, and Operations teams to turn business needs into practical AI solutions.

Key responsibilities

• Build and deploy LLM/Generative AI features from prompt design, orchestration, backend integration, release, and monitoring.

• Design and implement RAG systems, including embeddings, chunking, retrieval, reranking, citations, caching, and fallback mechanisms.

• Develop AI Agent workflows including tool calling, state management, task automation, retries, guardrails, and fallback models.

• Develop and maintain full-stack web applications supporting AI-powered products.

• Build scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or similar technologies.

• Integrate LLM APIs, third-party APIs, databases, and external services.

• Implement AI evaluation, regression testing, logging, monitoring, and observability to maintain AI quality and reliability.

• Optimize AI/application performance, latency, scalability, and cost through caching, batching, context optimization, and model routing.

• Apply security best practices including prompt-injection protection, PII handling, rate limiting, and abuse prevention.

• Collaborate with Product, Design, and Operations teams to develop AI solutions that improve user experience and operational efficiency.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

• 2–5 years of experience in AI Engineering, Full-Stack Development, Backend Engineering, or related roles.

• Fluent bilingual communication (Listening/Speaking/Reading/Writing) in Mandarin or English.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js/TypeScript or Python.

• Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, or similar.

• Hands-on experience integrating LLM/Generative AI APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar.

• Practical experience building AI Agents, agentic workflows, or AI-powered automation.

• Strong understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector search, tokens, LLM cost, context management, and hallucination mitigation.

• Experience with REST APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases, caching, queues, and third-party integrations.

• Familiarity with AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar cloud platforms.

• Strong software engineering practices including testing, debugging, logging, monitoring, documentation, and version control.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom AI orchestration.

• Experience with vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or Weaviate.

• Experience with n8n, Zapier, or other workflow automation tools.

• Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps and observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, or Sentry.

• Understanding of microservices architecture.

• Experience with STT/TTS or audio AI pipelines.

• Experience building AI products for e-commerce, procurement, recruitment, or business workflow platforms.

• Previous experience in a startup or fast-paced product environment.

If you're ready to embark on an exciting and rewarding journey for this position, we encourage you to apply now!
